It explains what happens at the desk for customers
Companion Animal Travel Desk Overview

This guide keeps the handoff tight and the record clear. The desk coordinates animal travel from booking through pickup, and every step needs fast review. Customers should present the required travel details early so the team can check the route, the carrier, and the cabin plan without delay.

For rabbit travel, <<FACT F082>> The certificate and booking file must stay aligned, or the desk must stop the release and send the case back for review. Use the same caution when a traveler asks for a change at the counter.

For cat travel, <<FACT F055>> The fee note must be captured with the reservation record before the animal is accepted. If the traveler arrives without the right support documents, pause the process and escalate at once. The cabin team will monitor the animal in flight, so the desk must confirm each handoff clearly.

If more help is needed, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk for immediate support.
